title: Printer shows offline
symptom: Printer shows as Offline on the computer
user_description: My computer says the printer is offline, but I can see it's switched on. I need to print an invoice now.

options.text: Check the printer is on and connected to the network, and that it is not set to 'Use Printer Offline'
options.why: An offline status usually means the PC cannot reach the printer or the printer is set to offline mode. Check power, connection and that setting first.
Far too drastic. Never start with the most destructive fix.
Wasteful. The existing printer is on and probably fine, so check connection and settings first.
Destructive and unrelated. It would lose the user's settings and files for a simple connection problem.

hints: The printer is on, so what could stop the PC reaching it?
Does Windows have a setting that pretends a printer is offline?
real_world_tip: Look at the printer's own screen first. If it shows an error or has lost its network connection, the fault is on the printer side, not the PC.
